annotations.title: Register a server behind your Rokha gateway

description: Register an external MCP server behind your Rokha GATEWAY — one endpoint that aggregates all your servers with credentials injected server-side. Any MCP client pointed at the gateway URL (with your Rokha token) then sees this server's tools namespaced <slug>_<tool>. secret_alias names a vault key/OAuth grant that authenticates it (omit for open servers). Requires a logged-in identity. Cap 20.

name.description: Short name — kebab-cased into the tool namespace.

secret_alias.description: Vault alias that authenticates it (omit for open servers).

name: gateway_register
